services.heading: Services
services.body: Need to present your idea, build an application or address a business need? I can help plan and develop the solution.

steps.title: Getting started
steps.description: We talk about your idea, what you need and what makes sense for the project.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: Layout and visual identity tailored to your project.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: I build the pages and features and make sure everything works together.

steps.title: Final adjustments
steps.description: Improvements based on your feedback before delivery.

steps.title: Delivery & support
steps.description: You get the finished project ready to use, with technical support.

steps.title: Ongoing partnership
steps.description: I stay available for updates and future projects.

offerings.title: Landing pages
offerings.description: A single page to present a product or service and make it easy to get in touch. Ideal for getting started online or promoting something new.

offerings.title: Business websites
offerings.description: A website with several pages to introduce your company, services and other important information. Everything is organized so your customers can find what they need.

offerings.title: Web applications
offerings.description: A system built for your company, with user access, information management and connections to other tools. Each feature is planned and built around what your business needs.

offerings.title: Other solutions
offerings.description: Does your business need something different? We can discuss the problem and find a way to solve it with technology, such as automating tasks, connecting tools or building a program for your work.
